senses.gloss: ch. (preced.; b. h. פּוּשׁ) [to be blown up,] to expand, grow larger, increase; to remain over.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 26:22">Targ. O. Gen. XXVI, 22</cite> (ed. Berl. <he>ויַפְשִׁינָנָא</he>, v. infra).—Part. <he>פָּשׁ</he>, <cite ref="Q01835"><he>פָּיֵישׁ</he></cite>, <he>פָּיֵשׁ</he>; pl. <he>פָּשָׁן</he>, <he>פַּיְישִׁין</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 6:11">Targ. Cant. VI, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 1:16">Ib. I, 16</cite>.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 106a:4">Keth. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>הוו פַיְישֵׁי וכ׳</he> there remained with him &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 89b:5">Sabb. 89ᵇ</cite> <he>פָּשׁוּ להו חמשין</he> there remain fifty; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:4">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>אף אינין לא פָשַׁת להון טב</he> with them, too, it did not prosper well, i.e. they did not end well (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:14">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ</cite> <he>לא נפקין טבאות</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 105:24">Targ. Ps. CV, 24</cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 36:24">Targ. Job XXXVI, 24</cite> <he>תָּפֵישׁ</he> (not <he>תְּפִישׁ</he>). Targ. Y. (a. O. ed. Berl.) Gen. l. c. <he>יַפְשִׁינָנָא</he> he will increase us (h. text <he>ופרינו</he>); a. e.—
Sabb. 32ᵃ תָּפֵישׁ תירוס וכ׳ (Ar. תֵּיפיּשׁ Pe.), v. מַחְטְרָא; Yalk. Gen. 31; a. e.—V. נְפֵישׁ.
